tests: [browsercontext-cookies.test] BrowserContext cookies BrowserContext.cookies should find partitioned cookie
reason: Sets a partitioned cookie and reads its partition back. Firefox and stock WebKit can't set one (`cookies.partitioned` is unsupported there, and Firefox doesn't say which partition a cookie is in). No matrix row names partitioned cookies, so this cites addCookies, the nearest row, as the cookies entries do

tests: [browsercontext-cookies.test] BrowserContext cookies BrowserContext.setCookie should set cookie with a partition key
reason: Sets a secure partitioned cookie and loads the fixture's HTTPS page, whose certificate is self-signed, so the test accepts it with `acceptInsecureCerts`. Chromium refuses that per context, since its certificate override applies to the whole browser (as the cookies entries for the frame case do)

tests: [browsercontext-cookies.test] BrowserContext cookies BrowserContext.deleteMatchingCookies should only delete cookies in the matching partition
[browsercontext-cookies.test] BrowserContext cookies BrowserContext.deleteMatchingCookies should not delete unpartitioned cookies when partitionKey is given
[browsercontext-cookies.test] BrowserContext cookies BrowserContext.deleteMatchingCookies should match hasCrossSiteAncestor in partitionKey
reason: Removes the cookies of one partition, or those matching a partition key. Strider's `CookieJar.remove` takes a name, domain and path, with no partition key, so it removes the cookie in every partition and the test's partitioned removal can't be written. No matrix row names a partition option for removal; this cites clearCookies, the nearest row, as the cookies entry for the partitioned deleteCookie does
